definitions.gloss: downtown, old town, low-lying area of a city
definitions.explanation: The older, traditional commercial and residential areas of a city, typically in lower-lying areas, associated with working-class culture and traditional atmosphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下町|したまち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{街並|まちな}み→街並み：10435_machinami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Old townscapes remain in Tokyo's downtown area.

examples.japanese: {下町|したまち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I like the atmosphere of the old downtown.

examples.japanese: {下町|したまち}⟦{育|そだ}ち→育ち：13927_sodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人情|にんじょう}→人情：11437_ninjou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: People raised in the old downtown are said to be warm-hearted.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{下町|したまち} refers to the traditional working-class areas of Japanese cities, particularly Tokyo. Areas like ⟦{浅草|あさくさ}→浅草：28393_asakusa⟧, ⟦{上野|うえの}→上野：28394_ueno⟧, and ⟦{両国|りょうごく}→両国：noentry⟧ are considered classic {下町|したまち}. It's associated with:
- ⟦{人情|にんじょう}→人情：11437_ninjou⟧ (warmth, humanity)
- ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧ (craftspeople)
- ⟦{伝統|でんとう}{的|てき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ (traditional shops)
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧ (festivals)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{山|やま}の{手|て}→山手：10184_yamanote⟧ (uptown, residential hillside areas)
